description_en: Creates a virtual node (VNode) to connect to a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, enabling the cluster to scale resources to Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
description_zh: 创建一个虚拟节点（VNode），用于对接自建Kubernetes集群，使其可以扩展资源到ECI
kebab_example: aliyun eci create-virtual-node --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-2ze81zoc3yl7a3we0000 --vswitch-id vsw-2ze23nqzig8inprou0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirtualNode

parameters.help_en: The security group ID. The virtual node and ECI instances created on the virtual node are added to this security group
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID。虚拟节点以及该虚拟节点下的ECI实例将加入到该安全组中
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. The vSwitch used by the virtual node and ECI instances created on the virtual node. You can specify 1 to 10 vSwitches that belong to the same VPC
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。虚拟节点以及虚拟节点下的ECI实例所使用的交换机。    
支持指定多个（1~10个）属于同一VPC的交换机。
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual node. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点的名称。长度为2~128个英文字符，可以包含小写英文字符、数字、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: virtual_node_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access. Default value: false. If you set this parameter to true, the virtual node exposes a public IP address
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持公网。默认为false。    
如果设置为true，则虚拟节点将对外暴露一个公网IP
parameters.name: enable_public_network

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic IP Address (EIP)
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The KubeConfig of the Kubernetes cluster to which the virtual node connects. The value must be Base64-encoded before being passed in
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点要连接的Kubernetes集群的KubeConfig。需进行Base64编码后传入
parameters.name: kube_config

parameters.help_en: The custom resources supported by the virtual node. If an ECI pod declares the corresponding custom resource in its request, the pod is scheduled to the VNode. The format is `resource_name=resource_count`. Separate multiple resources with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟节点支持的自定义资源。如果ECI Pod的request中声明了相应的自定义资源，则该Pod会被调度到VNode。
格式为`资源名称=资源数量`，多个资源之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: custom_resources

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the cluster. After this parameter is configured, Kubelet configures all containers to search this domain in addition to the search domains of the host
parameters.help_zh: 集群的域名。配置后，除了主机的搜索域外，Kubelet会配置所有容器来搜索该域名
parameters.name: cluster_domain

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the DNS server. If `dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst` is set in an ECI pod, this value is used to provide DNS services for the container. You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。如果ECI Pod中设置了`dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst`，则使用该配置值为容器提供DNS服务。
支持配置多个IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: cluster_dns

parameters.help_en: The tag information of the virtual node. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点标签信息。最多可以配置20个
parameters.name: tag

fields.help_en:
The effect of the taint. Valid values:

NoSchedule: Pods are not scheduled to the node that has this taint.
NoExecute: Pods are not scheduled to the node that has this taint, and existing pods on the node are evicted.
PreferNoSchedule: Pods are preferably not scheduled to the node that has this taint
fields.help_zh:
污点的Effect。取值范围：

NoSchedule：不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上。
NoExecute：不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上的同时，驱逐节点上已经存在的Pod。
PreferNoSchedule：尽量不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上
fields.name: effect

parameters.help_en: The taint information of the virtual node. You can specify up to 20 taints
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点污点信息。最多可以配置20个
parameters.name: taint

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If you enable this feature, use the KubeConfig certificate for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用TLS启动引导。启用后，请使用TLS启动引导的KubeConfig证书。取值范围：

true：启用
false：不启用

默认为false
parameters.name: tls_bootstrap_enabled
